# paired-first-turn

Provider: Codex.
Provider version: 0.142.5.
Source class: scrubbed capture.

Genuine same-thread pair: repository first-turn.jsonl (34 wire envelopes) and matching native rollout (12 rows). Source version 0.142.5; match established using native thread ID from wire thread/start response and rollout filename/header. Private context removed; IDs consistently aliased; sentinel prompt/final and five delta pieces replaced consistently. Native and observed timestamps are shifted to a neutral epoch; units and relative timing are retained. Expected output assembles the shared three conversation/reasoning items and retains source-only facts as observations. This does not prove parity for tool calls or newer versions.

Expected output is a research oracle for the proposed standard, not current Nano output. IDs beginning `item-` are fixture-local logical IDs. Nulls mean no evidence. Captured arrays may be reduced to four entries; prose, paths, and identities are neutralized.
